Our Heat Pump Repair Diagnostic & Safety Standards

Technicians dispatched to Lund perform comprehensive system testing using professional digital diagnostic gauges:

1

Reversing valve solenoid electrical energization and 4-way valve slide operation check

2

Defrost control board logic testing, defrost thermostat sensor, and cycle timing verification

3

Suction and liquid line refrigerant pressure measurements in heating mode

4

Compressor crankcase heater operation and hard-start capacitor verification

5

Auxiliary electric heat strip staging, sequencer continuity, and thermal limit safety checks
